observations: Seller claims they tested it yesterday, but no new photos/videos were provided.
The original photos still show an open container with many disassembled engine parts; no complete engine is shown and no readable engine code/VIN/label is visible.

claims.evidence: No RX350 identification visible in photos; seller text only.
No ES350 identification visible in photos; seller text only.
No IS250 identification visible in photos; seller text only.
No Camry identification visible in photos; seller text only.
No shipping/container markings or documents visible in photos.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No running video, no diagnostic printout, no mileage proof, and photos show disassembled parts; “never opened” cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: “I tested it myself yesterday, everything I said is true. Please check again.”
claims.evidence: Statement only; no new evidence provided to verify testing/no-knock/mileage/engine identity.

risks.risk: Engine/model mismatch or mixed parts (RX350/ES350/IS250/Camry engines differ; photos show many parts that may not belong to one confirmed engine).
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate stamped on the block (and/or donor VIN/engine code) plus a photo showing the exact complete engine assembly (not mixed parts).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as wrong/uncertain fit (worst case: buyer may not be able to install without sourcing correct parts).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” not verifiable without run proof.
risks.proof: Short cold-start video showing the engine running and a scan-tool/OBD health readout (or a diagnostic report) indicating no knock/healthy readings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven running (worst case: treat as not working).

risks.risk: “Never opened” cannot be confirmed; photos show internal components already separated.
risks.proof: Photos of factory seals/lock marks and close-ups of mating surfaces/timing cover areas showing whether internals were previously opened.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as previously opened/unknown internal condition (worst case: needs rebuild).

risks.risk: Missing or damaged components due to disassembly/shipping (sensors, bolts, timing parts, housings).
risks.proof: A detailed included-parts checklist with photos of each major component (starter, alternator, ECU, sensors, manifolds, timing components) and close-ups of critical areas (block/head surfaces, crank pulley area).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as may be incomplete/damaged (worst case: additional parts and labor required).

risks.proof: Donor mileage proof (auction sheet/VIN history) and/or odometer reading from the donor vehicle before dismantling.
risks.if_unproven: Priced without mileage advantage (worst case: treat as unknown mileage).

proof_requests: Send a short cold-start running video (from cold) showing no knock.
Send a diagnostic/scan-tool report (OBD readings) or any test sheet from the testing day.
Send clear close-up photos of the engine identification: engine code/ID plate stamped on the block (and any label).
Send photos showing the exact engine as a complete assembly (or confirm it’s a complete engine and not mixed parts), with all major components accounted for.
Send proof for “never opened” (factory seals/lock marks) and mileage (donor VIN/auction sheet).
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only a verbal insistence with no new evidence. The photos still do not confirm the exact engine/model, do not show running/test proof, and do not verify “never opened” or mileage, so the item cannot be priced reliably yet.
